dict.string: OmniGart on Apple Watch reads heart rate, HRV, workouts, and active and resting energy from Apple Health to show on-watch wellness estimates. Health data is not used for advertising or shared with third parties.

OmniGart on Apple Watch saves workouts you complete — with duration, active and resting energy, distance, and heart rate — to Apple Health so they appear in the Fitness app. Data is not used for ads or sold to third parties.

OmniGart may use Bluetooth during an indoor treadmill run to read speed, incline, and distance from a compatible treadmill, and for heart-rate accessories you choose. The watch app remains usable without an accessory.
Camera access is not required on Apple Watch for OmniGart; this description exists for shared permission strings with the iPhone app.
OmniGart can remind you about workouts and wellness check-ins you enable. The app works with notifications disabled.
